Sample Taxon Reports
```{r}
# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = "/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/experiment_all/sample_taxon_reports", pattern = ".*.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
seq_metrics = read.csv("/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/sequencing_summary_metrics_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Process all CSV files and combine them
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(csv_files, process_csv_file))

# Pond sample names
pond_samples = c("s9","s10","s19","s20")

# Create sample metadata using helper function
sample_metadata = create_sample_metadata(seq_metrics, pond_samples)

# Merge the taxonomy data with metadata
merged_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample_name")

# Filter to include only species level (tax_level == 1) to avoid duplication
species_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(tax_level == 1) %>% 
  filter(water_control == "No") %>%   # filter out Negative Controls
  filter(infection_class != "Definite") # filter out positive controls

# Recode values for publication
species_data = species_data %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_type = recode(sample_type, `environmental` = "wastewater"),
    library_prep = recode(library_prep, `NGS` = "mNGS")
  ) 
```

```{r}
species_data_filtered = species_data %>%

  filter(nt_alignment_length > 50)

```


```{r}
# Sequencing metrics ALL experiments
seq_metrics_all = sample_metadata %>% 
  filter(water_control == "No") %>%   # Filter out Negative Controls
  filter(infection_class != "Definite") %>%  # Filter out positive controls
  filter(!base_sample %in% c("s5-2")) %>% 
  filter(experiment == 1 | experiment == 3) %>% 
  mutate(
    total_reads_sub = total_reads * subsampled_fraction, # Subsample total reads according to subsample fraction
    total_reads_unique = total_reads / compression_ratio, # Unique reads
    sample_type = recode(sample_type, `environmental` = "wastewater"),
    library_prep = recode(library_prep, `NGS` = "mNGS")
  )

seq_metrics_summary = seq_metrics_all %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, total_reads, passed_filters) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(total_reads, passed_filters),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  ) 

```

```{r, results='asis'}
cat("\\captionsetup{labelformat=empty}")
# -------------------------
# Calculate viral percentages per sample
# -------------------------
sample_totals <- species_data %>%
  select(-sample_type) %>% 
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    total_nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nr_count = sum(nr_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nt_rpm   = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nr_rpm   = sum(nr_rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

virus_data <- species_data %>%
  filter(category == "viruses")

# Get non-phage viruses
virus_non_phage_data <- virus_data %>%
  filter(category == "viruses", is_phage == "false") %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(name, paste(c("phage","Caudoviricetes","CrAss","Mitoviridae","Crassvirales","Siphoviridae","Podoviridae","Myoviridae"), collapse = "|"))) 

# Add genus columns to the dataframe
genus_data <- get_genus_info_batch(virus_non_phage_data$tax_id, batch_size = 100)

# Combine with original dataframe
virus_non_phage_data <- cbind(virus_non_phage_data, genus_data) %>% 
  filter(!genus_name %in% c("Caudoviricetes sp.","Crassvirales sp.","Mitoviridae sp.","uncultured human fecal virus",
                            "Alphapapillomavirus","Nicoomyvirus","Myrnavirus","Lillamyvirus","Kahnovirus",
                            "Moumouvirus","Kehishuvirus","Gamaleyavirus","Tupanvirus","Audreyjarvisvirus",
                            "Mimivirus","Muminvirus","Immutovirus","Buhlduvirus","Phapecoctavirus",
                            "Samwavirus","Denvervirus","Ferozepurvirus","Wotdevirus",
                            "Miltoncavirus","Melianvirus","Cotonvirus","Justusliebigvirus","Tequatrovirus",
                            "Pawinskivirus","Cohcovirus","Tanisvirus","Matsuvirus","Kenoshavirus","Pacinivirus",
                            "Cedarrivervirus","Eurybiavirus","Kagunavirus","Lahexavirus",
                            "Marfavirus","Popoffvirus","Quivirus","Skogvirus","Tepukevirus","Traversvirus",
                            "Zhangjivirus","Aurodevirus","Lambovirus","Pahexavirus","Skunavirus",
                            "Tequatrovirus","Beenievirus","Brujitavirus","Lebriduvirus","Nevevirus","Pamirivirus",
                            "Rahariannevirus","Segzyvirus","Bertelyvirus","Buchananvirus","Ferozepurvirus","Kehishuvirus",
                            "Matsuvirus","Moabitevirus","Nieuwekanaalvirus","Serwervirus","Cimandefvirus","Denvervirus",
                            "Nipunavirus","Pawinskivirus","Sextaecvirus","Finchvirus","Haetaevirus","Ittyvirus","Muminvirus",
                            "Saltrevirus","Shandongvirus","Cohcovirus","Elemovirus","Fremauxvirus","Hattifnattvirus","Juiceboxvirus",
                            "Mydovirus","Omegavirus","Phapecoctavirus","Samwavirus","Shirahamavirus","Stormageddonvirus",
                            "Vicoquintavirus","Bihckevirus","Elmenteitavirus","Henunavirus","Justusliebigvirus","Menderavirus",
                            "Myradeevirus","Onyinyevirus","Plasmavirus","Shuimuvirus","Swiduovirus","Vipetofemvirus","Archimedesvirus",
                            "Bixzunavirus","Gamaleyavirus","Jwalphavirus","Kumottavirus","Miltoncavirus","Plateaulakevirus",
                            "Skatevirus","Tanisvirus","Wotdevirus","Buchavirus")) # filter out known phages

# All viruses including phages
viral_percentages <- virus_data %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = recode(sample_type, `environmental` = "wastewater")) %>% 
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep, sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    viral_nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_totals, by = c("base_sample", "library_prep")) %>%
  mutate(
    viral_nt_percent = (viral_nt_count / total_nt_count) * 100,
    viral_nt_percent = ifelse(is.nan(viral_nt_percent) | is.infinite(viral_nt_percent), NA, viral_nt_percent)
  )

viral_summary <- viral_percentages %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, viral_nt_count, viral_nt_percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(viral_nt_count, viral_nt_percent),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  )

# Only non-phage viruses
viral_percentages_non_phage <- virus_non_phage_data %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = recode(sample_type, `environmental` = "wastewater")) %>% 
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep, sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    non_phage_viral_nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_totals, by = c("base_sample", "library_prep")) %>%
  mutate(
    non_phage_viral_nt_percent = (non_phage_viral_nt_count / total_nt_count) * 100,
    non_phage_viral_nt_percent = ifelse(is.nan(non_phage_viral_nt_percent) | is.infinite(non_phage_viral_nt_percent), NA, non_phage_viral_nt_percent)
  )

viral_summary_non_phage <- viral_percentages_non_phage %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, non_phage_viral_nt_count, non_phage_viral_nt_percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(non_phage_viral_nt_count, non_phage_viral_nt_percent),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  )

# -------------------------
# Create seq_metrics_summary
# -------------------------
seq_metrics_summary_tbl <- seq_metrics_all %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, total_reads, passed_filters, compression_ratio) %>%
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep) %>%  # ensure single row per sample+prep
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(total_reads),
    passed_filters = sum(passed_filters),
    compression_ratio = mean(compression_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(total_reads, passed_filters, compression_ratio),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  ) %>%
  left_join(viral_summary, by = "base_sample") %>%
  left_join(viral_summary_non_phage, by = "base_sample") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.)))) %>%  # convert any list-columns to numeric
  mutate(
    passed_filters_msspe = (passed_filters_MSSPE / total_reads_MSSPE) * 100,
    passed_filters_mngs   = (passed_filters_mNGS / total_reads_mNGS) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(base_sample, total_reads_mNGS, total_reads_MSSPE,
         passed_filters_mngs, passed_filters_msspe,
         compression_ratio_mNGS, compression_ratio_MSSPE,
         viral_nt_percent_mNGS, viral_nt_percent_MSSPE, non_phage_viral_nt_percent_mNGS, non_phage_viral_nt_percent_MSSPE) %>%
  arrange(desc(viral_nt_percent_MSSPE))

# All experiments
seq_metrics_summary_kbl <- seq_metrics_summary_tbl %>%
  rename(
    "Sample" = base_sample,
    "Reads (MSSPE)" = total_reads_MSSPE,
    "Reads (mNGS)" = total_reads_mNGS,
    "Passed Filter % (MSSPE)" = passed_filters_msspe,
    "Passed Filter % (mNGS)" = passed_filters_mngs,
    "DCR (mNGS)" = compression_ratio_mNGS,
    "DCR (MSSPE)" = compression_ratio_MSSPE,
    "Viral Reads (MSSPE)" = viral_nt_percent_MSSPE,
    "Viral Reads % (mNGS)" = viral_nt_percent_mNGS,
    "Non-phage Reads % (MSSPE)" = non_phage_viral_nt_percent_MSSPE,
    "Non-phage Reads % (mNGS)" = non_phage_viral_nt_percent_mNGS,
  ) %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "",
    digits = 2,
    align = "lrrrrrrrrrr",   
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position","scale_down"), 
    position = "center",
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 9
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%  
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major") 
```



```{r}
seq_metrics_all %>% 
    group_by(library_prep) %>%
    summarize(mean_reads = mean(total_reads),
              mean_reads_sub = mean(total_reads_sub),
              mean_reads_unique = mean(total_reads_unique))

seq_metrics_all_long <- seq_metrics_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(total_reads, total_reads_unique, total_reads_sub, passed_filters),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("total_reads", "total_reads_unique", "total_reads_sub", "passed_filters")),
         value = value / 1e6, # Convert to millions of reads
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      "total_reads" = "Total",
      "total_reads_unique" = "Unique",
      "total_reads_sub" = "Subsample",
      "passed_filters" = "QC"
    )
  )

plot_data <- seq_metrics_all_long %>%
  group_by(library_prep, metric) %>%
  summarize(mean_value = mean(value), sd_value = sd(value), .groups = "drop")

overall_boxplot <- ggplot(
  seq_metrics_all_long,
  aes(x = library_prep, y = value, fill = metric)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = 21,
    outlier.size = 1.6,
    outlier.fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Total" = "#3C8DBC",
      "Unique" = "#8E6FB3",
      "Subsample" = "#BDC3C7",
      "QC" = "#7F8C8D"
    ),
    name = ""
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "a",
    x = "",
    y = "Reads (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )
overall_boxplot
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Create boxplot for viral NT percentage by control status
mean_df_viral_perc <- viral_percentages_non_phage %>%
  group_by(library_prep, sample_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(non_phage_viral_nt_percent, na.rm = TRUE))

viral_summary_wilcox = viral_summary_non_phage %>% 
    mutate(
    viral_nt_percent_mNGS = replace_na(non_phage_viral_nt_percent_mNGS, 0), # set NAs to 0 for non detections
    viral_nt_percent_MSSPE   = replace_na(non_phage_viral_nt_percent_MSSPE, 0), # set NAs to 0 for non detections
    )

# Paired Wilcoxon test BY sample type
viral_wide <- viral_percentages_non_phage %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, sample_type, non_phage_viral_nt_percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = non_phage_viral_nt_percent
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mNGS = replace_na(mNGS, 0),
    MSSPE = replace_na(MSSPE, 0)
  )

wilcox_results <- viral_wide %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      mNGS,
      MSSPE,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x = 1.5,
    y = max(viral_percentages_non_phage$non_phage_viral_nt_percent, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  )

library_prep_levels <- levels(factor(viral_percentages_non_phage$library_prep))


viral_nt_boxplot <- ggplot(viral_percentages_non_phage, aes(x = library_prep, y = non_phage_viral_nt_percent, color = sample_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    outlier.fill = "white",
    outlier.alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = sample_type),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.10,
      dodge.width  = 0.75
    ),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  geom_text(
    data = wilcox_results,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 3.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(
      label = round(..y.., 1),
      group = sample_type      
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.7,               # lift above the box
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_segment(data = mean_df_viral_perc,
               aes(x = as.numeric(library_prep) - 0.3,
                   xend = as.numeric(library_prep) + 0.3,
                   y = mean_value, yend = mean_value),
               linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "b",
    x = "",
    y = "% Viral Reads",
    fill = "Sample type",
    color = "Sample type"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
    )


viral_nt_boxplot
```
